description.en: When high school student Akio Asakura loses a high speed race to a Porsche 911 Turbo known as “Blackbird,” he goes to a junkyard to find parts for his car – only to discover a blue first-generation Datsun Fairlady Z (S30), which he buys. Akio later discovers that not only is the Z tuned to 620 bhp, it’s had a dark history of unfortunate accidents with its previous owners. Making matters more complicated is the fact that the last owner shared the same name with Akio. With the “Devil Z,” Akio forms a new rivalry with the Blackbird and its driver Tatsuya Shima.

A few years have passed since Goku first met Uub, he's become satisfied that Uub is becoming stronger while he trains him so decides to take him to the next Tenkaichi Budokai tournament in order to test him.  
  
In the background, a mysterious adversary from a different universe, Universe 0 (This was long before Dragon Ball Super) wants to return to our universe. In order to achieve that task, he requires the power of the Dragon Balls, and has revived Babidi in order to accomplish that goal.  
  
Babidi soon awakens the remnants of Majin Buu sleeping deep within Uub and turns him into his puppet. Now it's up to Goku and Co. to stop this new adversary from crossing over into their universe at all costs!

description.en:
One day, ordinary elementary school student Mitsuo Suwa meets an alien in an empty lot, who appoints him as the hero of justice, "Perman No. 1"! Together with the chimpanzee No. 2, the tomboyish girl with an unknown identity No. 3, and reliable Osaka native No. 4, they save lives and fight evil!

The series gained huge popularity in the late 1960s in Weekly Shonen Sunday and educational magazines for different grades, and was continued in the 1980s with a new setting. This version includes all episodes, including early versions not available in the original volumes and the stories featuring Perman No. 5, as well as the magazine's feature pages and the bonus features on the back cover of the original comic.

Welcome to Yani's apartment. Please don't mind the smell. 

Yani is a catgirl with a seriously bad smoking habit.  Every time she tries to quit, she becomes weak to the cravings and gives in almost instantly. 

Behind on her rent and unable to hold down a job, her friends and sister rally around to help her out. 

But when she's using her pee to put out cigarette fires, they may just have their work cut out for them. Will she ever get her life together, or is she doomed to live as a chainsmoking slob forever?

Atrasada con la renta e incapaz de mantener un trabajo estable, sus amigos y su hermana se unen para ayudarla. description.en:
Daily Chaldea is an unofficial daily slice-of-life fancomic created using art assets from the game Fate/Grand Order and building upon the existing lore of the franchise.

The story follows the adventures of genderswapping protagonist Ritsuka Fujimaru and the many Servants they've summoned, with the tone ranging from comedic to philosophical. The comic is 'live' with the NA server of Fate/Grand Order, with new characters appearing in the comic around the time they appear in the game and comics often referencing recent events in the game.

Enjoyment of this comic relies heavily upon the reader's familiarity with the game and its characters, so the author recommends playing Fate/Grand Order before reading this comic.

description.en:
Early Taishou Era.

Yuu is born to a mistress of the Todou Family, a prominent family, and is mistreated and treated like a slave from an early age.
In particular, her half-sister Nadeshiko pretends to be friendly with Yuu in front of Shinnosuke, whom she has a crush on, but behind her back, Nadeshiko bullies Yuu to no end.
Yuu had hoped to be free someday, but she was unable to do so because she could not abandon her mother, who was locked up in a dungeon.
One day, her mother dies in an unexplained fire, and Yuu, who went to save her, also disappears.

Seven years later, Yuu, who was thought to have disappeared, grows up beautifully as if she were a different person, changes her name to Haruhi, returns to the Todou family, and begins to take revenge for the death of her murdered mother.
description.ja:
大正初期。
名家・藤堂家の妾の子として生まれた憂雨（ゆう）は、幼い頃より虐げられ奴隷のように扱われていた。
特に腹違いの姉・撫子（なでしこ）は、好意を寄せている慎之介（しんのすけ）の前では憂雨と仲のいいふりをしつつ、陰では徹底的に憂雨をいじめていた。
いつか自由になりたいと願う憂雨だったが、座敷牢に監禁されている母を見捨てられず叶わずにいた。
そんなある日、原因不明の火事によって母が亡くなり、助けにいった憂雨もそのまま消息を絶ってしまう。
――7年後、消息を絶ったとされていた憂雨は、別人のように美しく成長し「春陽（はるひ）」と名前を変え藤堂家へ舞い戻り、殺された母の死を胸に復讐を始める。

description.en:
Otaku Sakamichi Onoda has just entered high school and plans to join the anime club. In middle school, Onoda didn't have any friends with whom he could talk about anime, games, Akihabara and other otaku things, and he is hoping he can make such friends in the anime club, but he finds out it's been disbanded. In order to reestablish the club he tries to find 4 other people who would like to join.

Since he was a little boy, Onoda has ridden his mamachari–a bulky bicycle with a step-through frame mainly used for short rides, such as for casual fun or to pick up groceries–to go to Akihabara every week to check out or buy otaku things. Fellow freshman Shunsuke Imaizumi and bicyclist, while training, notices a boy (Onoda) riding his mamachari up a steep road.

Freshman and road racing cyclist, Shokichi Naruko visits Akihabara to get some Gundam plastic models for his younger brothers and meets Onoda who catches his attention because of the his cycling skill on the mamachari and later find out they go to the same school. Later on, both Naruko and Imaizumi try to convince him to join the bicycle racing club, but will he?
___

A história inicia com um cara que se meteu no rapto de uma garota contra a sua vontade, todos menos ele acabam mortos pela garota, que ele descobre ser um dos híbridos, competindo com outros de sua raça em duelos mortais envolvendo complexas apostas. description.en: Shiki Nekoma, a junior high school student, absolutely hates his own young-sounding, high-pitched voice. Teased by those around him as "Soprano," he struggles with his confidence as a young man. However, he hides a secret identity that he cannot tell anyone. Using his cute voice as a weapon, he operates as "Nekono Hime Nyarunyan," a rapidly growing VTuber. While his hated voice is passionately loved on the other side of the screen, Shiki is left with complicated feelings. Then one day, he discovers that his childhood friend, Kagechika, is actually a hardcore fan of Nyarunyan...!?
description.ja: 自分の幼くて高い声が大嫌いな中学生・猫間史姫。周りからは「ソプラノ」と揶揄われ、男としての自信を持てずにいた。しかし、彼には誰にも言えない「裏の顔」がある。それはカワボを武器に、登録者急増中のＶＴｕｂｅｒ「猫乃姫にゃるにゃん」として活動していること。大嫌いなはずの声が、画面の向こうでは熱狂的に愛され、複雑な気持ちの史姫だったが、ある日、幼馴染みの景近がにゃるにゃんのガチオタであることが分かり…？

description.en: One day, I woke up as a noble inside the game I used to play. Unfortunately, the game ends in an apocalypse. With ten years left, I track down the future villains while they’re still kids and decide to raise them myself, hoping that a better childhood could stop them from destroying the world. Now, with criminals dropping like flies, the kingdom thinks I’m the terrifying mastermind pulling all the strings. What on earth is happening? I just wanted to enjoy the sweet noble life!
description.fr: Un jeune actif passionné de RPG se retrouve transposé dans le corps d'un antagoniste secondaire du jeu Psychedelia. Seulement voilà, sa nouvelle vie de noble provilégié est menacée par l'arrivée des 5 péchés capitaux, prêts à détruire le monde dans 10 ans. Pour éviter cela, il les prend sous son aile avant qu'ils ne soient irrécupérables et devient leur bienfaiteur. Cependant, la situation va vite prendre un tournant très inattendu...
description.id: Alon Palatio adalah seorang budak korporat yang masuk ke dalam dunia game bernama Psychedelia sebagai seorang bangsawan. Meski bergelar bangsawan, dia hanyalah karakter figuran yang ditakdirkan mati di tangan kelompok villain bernama 5 Dosa Besar. Demi bertahan hidup dan menikmati kehidupan bangsawan, dia memutuskan untuk mencegah para calon penjahat itu jatuh ke jalan kegelapan dengan menjadi sponsor mereka saat mereka masih kecil.
description.ko: 좋소 노예인 내가 게임 속 귀족으로 빙의되었다. 근데 미래의 악당들에게 죽는 엑스트라라고? 이들을 교화시켜 어떻게든 귀족 생활을 누리고 말 테다! 아직 어린 악당들의 흑화를 막기 위해 후원했고, 어려운 환경을 극복하게 만들어줬다. 그 결과 뿌듯함이 느껴질 만큼 모두 훌륭하고 평범하게 자랐다. 그렇게 나는 왕국의 최종 흑막이 되었다. …예?
description.ru:
Я, бывший раб корпорации, перевоплотился в дворянина в игре.
Но говорят, я всего лишь статист, который умрёт от рук будущих злодеев? Я должен перевоспитать их и во что бы то ни стало насладиться дворянской жизнью!

Так я стал покровителем ещё юных злодеев, чтобы предотвратить их падение в тьму, и помог им преодолеть тяжёлые времена.
В итоге благодаря мне все они выросли замечательными и обычными людьми.

И я стал главным закулисным злодеем королевства.
– Чего...?
description.th: ฉัน มนุษย์เงินเดือนที่ถวายชีวิตให้กับบริษัท อยู่ดี ๆ กลับตื่นขึ้นมาในร่างของขุนนางภายในเกมเสียอย่างงั้น!? แถมตัวละครที่ฉันสิงอยู่ยังเป็นแค่ตัวประกอบที่ถูกลิขิตให้ตายด้วยน้ำมือของเหล่าตัวร้ายในอนาคตอีกต่างหาก! ไม่มีทางหรอก! ฉันจะทำให้พวกเด็กเกเรพวกนั้นกลับตัว แล้วใช้ชีวิตขุนนางอย่างสงบสุขให้ได้! เพื่อป้องกันไม่ให้เหล่าตัวร้ายวัยเด็กกลายเป็นปีศาจ ฉันจึงอุปการะพวกเขา ช่วยให้พวกเขาผ่านพ้นชีวิตอันโหดร้าย จนพวกเขาทั้งหมดเติบโตขึ้นเป็นคนดี มีคุณธรรม และดู "ปกติ" อย่างสมบูรณ์แบบ และด้วยเหตุนี้เอง…ฉันถึงได้กลายเป็น บอสคนสุดท้ายของอาณาจักร!? ...เดี๋ยวสิ อะไรนะ!?
description.zh:
一不小心养成了世界级误会
只想活着怎么就成大BOSS了
想在游戏世界里当个安稳贵族，却发现自己竟是注定被未来反派杀掉的路人角色。为了活下去，他提前出手扶养、资助、引导那些还未堕落的危险人物。本以为成功改变命运，却在不知不觉中，被整个王国视作操纵一切的幕后黑手。明明什么都没做坏事，为什么结局会变成这样？
description.zh-hk: 曾為社畜的我穿越成為了遊戲中的貴族角色，雖然偏偏是個未來將被反派殺害的支線路人，但是沒關係！就讓我用金錢的力量，好好教化這群還是小小孩的反派角色，並享受成為貴族的優渥待遇吧！ 皇天不負苦心人，在認真的栽培之下，他們全都成長為平凡的大人，然而我…卻成了王國中的最終BOSS?!

Его блюда, созданные с любовью, нравятся не только людям, но и мазоку, эльфам и другим существам, вне зависимости от их происхождения. История разворачивается в этом уютном заведении, где переплетаются радости и горести, создавая увлекательный рассказ о гастрономическом путешествии.

description.en:
After being reincarnated into the world of the popular RPG Albater, a former gamer discovers that he hasn't become the protagonist or one of the game's legendary heroes. Instead, he's now Eisuke, a minor supporting character whose class is Alchemist. Being a background character doesn't bother Eisuke in the slightest. Armed with extensive knowledge of the game, he plans to take full advantage of his alchemy skills, make a fortune, and live a successful life far away from the dangers awaiting the story's main cast.

But staying in the background proves easier said than done. Before long, Eisuke crosses paths with Ain, the game's supposed protagonist, only to discover that the “hero” is nowhere near as capable as he should be. Worse, if Ain dies, the entire world could be doomed. Eisuke reluctantly begins using his knowledge and abilities to support him, gradually earning far more attention than any minor character is supposed to receive. As he forms a party with the game's heroes and heroines, Eisuke's supposedly humble support role becomes increasingly indispensable. He may have been reincarnated as a mere side character, but before he knows it, his talents as an alchemist are putting him on the path toward becoming a legend in his own right.
___

description.en:
Shirayuki, a young girl born with unique apple-red hair, happens to meet a famous but foolish young man, Prince Raji. He falls in love with Shirayuki at first sight, and orders her to become his concubine.  
  
Determined to do whatever it takes to resist his advances, but with nowhere else to go, Shirayuki cuts her hair and escapes to a neighboring country. While traversing through the forests, she meets an injured boy, Zen. After she boldly heals his wounds, he in return helps her. Meanwhile, Prince Raji sends out his henchmen to search for her.  
  
What will become of Shirayuki? What is Zen’s true character? A refreshing fantasy story between an optimistic heroine and a prince who constantly stays on her watch.  
  
**Extra stories:**  
v01 - Hachigatsu no Shikisa (Four-season Colour of August)  
v02 - Bokura o Tsunaide. (Bind Us)  
v14 - Natsu Yasumi Zero Zero Nichime (00 Day of Summer Holiday)
description.es: Shirayuki, una joven nacida con un singular cabello rojo manzana, conoce por casualidad a un joven famoso pero insensato, el príncipe Raji. Éste se enamora de Shirayuki a primera vista y le ordena que se convierta en su concubina. Decidida a hacer lo que sea para resistirse a sus avances, pero sin ningún otro sitio al que ir, Shirayuki se corta el pelo y escapa a un país vecino. Mientras atraviesa los bosques, conoce a un niño herido, Zen. Después de que ella le cure sus heridas, él la ayuda a ella. Mientras tanto, el príncipe Raji envía a sus secuaces a buscarla. ¿Qué será de Shirayuki? ¿Cuál es el verdadero carácter de Zen? Una refrescante historia de fantasía entre una heroína optimista y un príncipe que la vigila constantemente.
description.pt-br:
Shirayuki, uma jovem que nasceu com um cabelo ruivo-maçã único, conhece um jovem famoso, mas tolo, o príncipe Raji. Ele se apaixona por Shirayuki à primeira vista e ordena que ela se torne sua concubina.  
  
Determinada a fazer o que for preciso para resistir aos seus avanços, mas sem ter para onde ir, Shirayuki corta o cabelo e foge para um país vizinho. Enquanto atravessava as florestas, ela conhece um menino ferido, Zen. Depois que ela corajosamente cura suas feridas, ele em troca a ajuda. Enquanto isso, o Príncipe Raji envia seus capangas para procurá-la.  
  
O que será de Shirayuki? Qual é o verdadeiro caráter do Zen? Uma refrescante história de fantasia entre uma heroína otimista e um príncipe que permanece constantemente sob sua vigilância.

Động lực sống của nữ sinh cấp 3 Harumi Junna là được theo dõi và ủng hộ thần tượng Tsukishiro Fuwari!

Bien que cela puisse sembler être un paradis pour certains, la majorité des élèves sont des délinquantes, et Saotome se retrouve aussitôt extorqué par certaines des filles les plus agressives. description.en:
The “Three School Beauties” everyone admires—Karasumaru Kage, Ono Tsukasa, and Daigo Sakurako. For a poor, lonely guy like me, Kyousaka Kei, they were supposed to be out of my league… until I saved them from a potential assault and they became intensely fond of me.
“I want to get closer to you, even just a little. I want to know more about you, Kyousaka.”
Then, they asked me to do a part-time job fulfilling their requests. I thought it would be simple errands, but things gradually escalated…
“Hey, hug me tight.”
“Wanna kiss?”
“Touch me there. Harder.”
And it’s all because— “““It’s okay, it’s part of the job.”””
A lovey-dovey life at 5,000 yen per hour… Is this… being a kept man?
“Yes. We want to take care of you, Kei-kun.”
Tempted by 3 Beautiful Girls—Even Cuddling is Part of a Kept Man’s Job.
description.ja:
皆が憧れる「校内三大美女」――烏丸千景、小野司、醍醐桜子。
貧乏でぼっちな僕、京坂京にとっては雲の上の存在……なはずだった。
襲われそうな三人を助けて、熱烈に好かれるまでは。

「私は一歩でも距離を縮めたい。京坂のことをもっと知りたい」

そして頼まれたのは、彼女たちの要望を叶えるバイト。
ただの雑用かと思ったら、次第にエスカレートし……
「ね、ぎゅーっとして」「キスとかしちゃう～？」「そこ、触って。もっと強く」
それもこれも――「「「大丈夫、バイトの一環だから」」」

時給5000円のいちゃらぶ生活……これ、ヒモってやつ？

description.en:
Orchestrated by genius scientist Akihiko Kayaba, the SAO Incident created a game you couldn't leave until you beat it.
One where death in the game meant death in the real world... Kirito is a survivor of SAO who now spends his time playing the new VRMMORPG Alfheim Online with his old SAO friends, Asuna and Alice.
But Kirito soon finds himself caught up in a mysterious game he never expected...

(Source: Yen Press)
description.ja:
クリアするまで脱出不可能、ゲーム内での死＝現実世界での死を意味するデスゲーム――

天才科学者・茅場晶彦によって引き起こされた≪SAO事件≫から生還した少年、キリト。数多の事件の中で出会ったアスナやアリス、友人たちとVRMMORPGの一つである≪アルヴヘイム・オンライン≫で遊んでいたキリトは、突如、謎のゲームに巻き込まれることになり――！？
description.es-la: Ha pasado un año desde el regreso de Kirito y Asuna del Underworld. Con ellos está Alice, que ha recibido un cuerpo físico. Pero su paz se rompe rápidamente cuando los tres se ven empujados de repente a un juego desconocido, Unital Ring. Este nuevo mundo es un MMO de supervivencia que fusiona todos los VRMMO creados con el programa "The Seed". Nada más empezar, Kirito se encuentra sin nada más que su ropa interior. Ahora, ¡Tiene que desafiar a un misterioso VRMMOSVG en circunstancias desesperadas!

description.en: Jashin-chan Dropkick is a violent slapstic comedy about a delusional gothic lolita, Yurine, who summons a demon girl with the tail of a cobra, Jashin-chan. They'll have to live together until Yurine finds a way to send Jashin-chan back to hell, or until Jashin-chan kills Yurine.
description.ja:
魔界の悪魔、通称「邪神ちゃん」は、ある日突然、人間界に召喚されてしまう。
彼女を召喚したのは、神保町のボロアパートで暮らす、ちょっとブラックな心を持つ女子大生、花園ゆりねだった。しかもゆりねは、邪神ちゃんを魔界に帰す方法がわからないと言う。仕方なく一緒に暮らし始めた邪神ちゃんとゆりね。しかし、召喚者が死ねば魔界に帰れることから邪神ちゃんはゆりねを……!?
少女と邪神ちゃんが繰り広げるちょっとキケンな同居生活コメディ！
description.pt-br:
Jashin-chan Dropkick é uma comédia violenta sobre uma lolita gótica, Yurine, que invoca uma garota demônio com um rabo de cobra, Jashin-chan.
Elas terão que viver juntas até que Yurine encontre uma maneira de enviar Jashin-chan de volta ao inferno, ou até que Jashin-chan mate Yurine.

description.en: Song Yunxiang, the last Star Soul General of the Human Race, brought the system back to the campus era.  When he was a teenager, he was blinded by the incomplete soul, because he was weak and could only watch his relatives and friends die in front of him.  In this life, he returned with a system rebirth, with 60 years of combat experience and knowledge and technology, and returned to school. From then on, he used to build mechas to fight monsters... The things that have regretted, the people who have missed, this time will not leave regrets.
description.zh: 人族最后一位星魂师宋云祥，带着系统重生回校园时代。 少年时曾因为魂脉残缺遭人白眼，因为弱小只能眼睁睁看着亲友战死在自己身前。 这一世，带着系统重生归来，拥有六十年的战斗经验和知识技术，重返校园，从此一路开挂造机甲打怪兽… 曾经后悔的事，曾经错过的人，这一次将不留遗憾。

Isn't it the best when guys fall in love with each other? 

A boys' comedy featuring an unlikely duo: A high school boy who wants a girlfriend VS An angel who wants to make all men into BL! 

Fuwa Itaru, a high school student with zero romantic experience, was looking forward to meeting new friends and a future girlfriend as he started his new life, but he was depressed by the reality that high school life was different from what he had imagined. Suddenly, Remi Emonier, who calls herself a "super elite angel," appears and tries to shoot Cupid's arrow so that Itaru can find a romantice connection, but where does it land...? Only men!? -- The angel who descended upon Itaru was a BL-loving angel.

description.en:
Ed Rothstaylor is a third-rate villain in a game, disowned by his family and kicked out of the dormitory for his misdeeds. One day, our main character wakes up as this very Ed, and realizes he must earn a scholarship so he can graduate and be set for life. 

Now living in the woods, he resolves to keep away from the protagonists, but four of the female leads just won't leave him alone. Not only that, his presence starts to change the timeline and events of the game! 

Can Ed help the story progress while staying out of the limelight?

---
***Note:** LINE Webtoon (Official English) has made changes to the main character's "original emotional facial expressions" in some chapters like for examples, CH.01, CH.02 and CH.06 is changed while it's kept in all other official language platforms.*
description.fr: Après avoir fini son jeu préféré «L'Épéiste raté de Sylvania» plus de cinq fois, un joueur se retrouve aspiré au début de l'histoire pour la recommencer dans le rôle ingrat d'un méchant personnage secondaire, détesté de tous et renié par sa famille, avec lequel il devra composer pour survivre à l'académie!
description.id: Kehidupanku berubah saat menjadi tokoh antagonis ekstra game favoritku. Padahal aku hanya ingin hidup santai tanpa ambisi, tapi sulit sekali bertahan di dunia ini. Pokoknya aku harus bertahan hidup dengan cara yang tak terbayangkan oleh para pemeran utama!
description.it: Ed Rothstaylor è un antagonista di terza categoria, ripudiato dalla sua famiglia e cacciato dai dormitori per i suoi misfatti. Un giorno, il nostro protagonista si sveglia nei panni di questo stesso Ed, e realizza di dover ottenere una borsa di studio così da potersi diplomare ed essere sistemato per il resto della sua vita. Costretto a vivere nei boschi, decide di stare alla larfa dai protagonisti, ma quattro delle ragazze principali non vogliono lasciarlo in pace. Non solo questo, la sua presenza inizia ad alterare la linea temporale e gli eventi del gioco! Riuscirà Ed ad aiutare la storia a proseguire, mentre si tiene lontano dai riflettori?
description.ja: 好きだったゲームの三流エキストラ悪役に転生してしまった。 野望はなく、ただおとなしく暮らしたい。しかしこの世は、生き残るのが本当に大変だ。 主人公にはできない三流悪役のやり方で、俺はこの物語の結末を迎えるために生き残るぞ！
description.ko:
즐겨하던 게임의 삼류 엑스트라 악역으로 빙의했다.
야망은 없고 그냥 조용히 살고 싶다. 근데 세상이 참 살아남기 힘들다.
주인공이 할 수 없는 삼류 악역의 방식으로, 난 이 이야기의 끝을 맞이하기 위해 살아남는다!
description.pl: Ed Rothstaylor to trzeciorzędny złoczyńca w grze, wyrzucony przez swoją rodzinę i wyrzucony z akademika za swoje złe uczynki. Pewnego dnia nasz główny bohater budzi się jako właśnie ten Ed i zdaje sobie sprawę, że musi zdobyć stypendium, aby ukończyć szkołę i zapewnić sobie przyszłość. Teraz mieszkając w lesie, postanawia trzymać się z dala od protagonistów, ale cztery z głównych bohaterek nie dają mu spokoju. Co więcej, jego obecność zaczyna zmieniać fabułę i wydarzenia w grze! Czy Ed pomoże w rozwoju historii, pozostając w cieniu?
description.ru:
Эд Лостейлор — третьесортный злодей в игре, отвергнутый семьей и изгнанный из общежития за свои проступки. Судьба делает неожиданный поворот, когда наш герой пробуждается в теле этого самого Эда и осознаёт: единственный путь к благополучному будущему — получить стипендию и окончить обучение.

Обосновавшись в лесной глуши, он твёрдо решает держаться подальше от главных героев игры. Однако четыре прекрасные героини словно заворожены им и никак не желают оставить его в покое. Более того, само его существование начинает искажать временную линию, меняя предначертанный ход событий!

Удастся ли Эду сохранить баланс между невмешательством и необходимостью двигать сюжет вперёд, оставаясь при этом в тени? Ведь каждое его действие может изменить судьбу целого мира...
description.zh:
从恶棍到生存王
打破命运的束缚！
意外穿成游戏中的三流反派，只想安稳低调地活下去。但这个世界却生存艰难！无法像主角那样光芒万丈，只能用三流反派的方式，在故事的尽头努力活下来！
description.pt-br: Eu possuía um personagem vilão extra de terceira categoria em meu jogo favorito. Não tenho ambições e só quero viver uma vida tranquila. Mas, caramba, este mundo é um lugar difícil de sobreviver. Eu sobreviverei até o final desta história, de uma forma que o protagonista não conseguirá. Sobreviverei à maneira de um personagem vilão de terceira categoria.
description.zh-hk: 轉生到自己最喜歡的遊戲後，我成為了不起眼的三流反派角色。雖然只想安安靜靜地生活，但是在這個世界很難生存下去。我沒什麼野心，目標就只有從學院畢業。 為了迎接這個故事的結局，我會用主角做不到的三流反派方式活下來！

description.en: Nakamura Kano is an OL (office lady) with a secret… she’s a “Toku Otaku,” a tokusatsu otaku who is obsessed with live action dramas of heroes, monsters and robots. She thinks they’re “JUST TOO COOL!” She’s so obsessed that she skips out on drinking with colleagues to watch it on TV and collects the DVDs, books and figurines. She lives her life by the code of the tokusatsu heroes, and constantly imagines them to help her through difficult situations. But this isn’t easy when all of her co-workers think that people who like anime and other childish things are weird, and they keep trying to make her socialize.

description.en:
One day, on his day off, Ogami Yuusuke happens to come across his classmate, Nanase Hiyori, confronting her childhood friend, Yoshihide Kouma
The two had actually been secretly dating for a year, but during that time, Yoshihide was also dating other girls, cheating on Hiyori.
After Yoshihide brazenly throws some cruel words at her, Hiyori runs off heartbroken. Unable to just leave her alone, Yuusuke follows her and decides to talk to her.
This becomes the start of their friendship, and Yuusuke gradually grows closer to Hiyori.
description.ja:
尾上雄介は、ある日の休日にクラスメイトの七瀬ひよりが幼馴染の江間仁秀を問い詰めている場面に遭遇する。
実は二人は一年前からこっそりと付き合っていたのだが、仁秀は同じ時期に他の女子とも付き合い、ひよりに二股をかけていた。

開き直った仁秀から最低な言葉を浴びせられ、傷心のままにその場を飛び出したひよりを放っておけなかった雄介は、彼女を追って話をすることに。
このことを切っ掛けに二人の交流が始まり、雄介はひよりと少しずつ仲良くなっていく。
